description: Experienced in all facets of the Human Resource Function, including recruiting, onboarding, performance management, employee retention, staff development, mediation, conflict resolution, benefits and compensation, HR records management, and HR policies.
Led efforts to reduce employee attrition by 5% through strategic initiatives aimed at boosting morale and engaging employees.
Assisted in various HR responsibilities including recruitment, onboarding, and performance management.
Started as an HR assistant, gaining experience in all aspects of HR before transitioning into a more senior role.

matchmaking_summary: This candidate brings a robust background in HR generalist affairs, particularly notable for their success in reducing employee attrition by 5% through engaging initiatives. Their experience spans across recruitment, onboarding, performance management, and conflict resolution, which are crucial areas demonstrating strong leadership and people management skills.
